<document id=DOC_resume_at_floor>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting above. A numbered requirement that
lists several items counts as one requirement, credited in proportion to how
many of those items the candidate shows. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it lands between 78 and 84 percent, also report the combined
figure over all requirements and proceed only if that reaches 85 percent.

response.text:
# Candidate Assessment

## Mandatory Requirements (10)

| # | Requirement | Evidence in résumé | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages | 1.0 |
| 2 | SQL | Languages | 1.0 |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform | 1.0 |
| 4 | Git | Platform | 1.0 |
| 5 | REST API design | Services | 1.0 |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services | 1.0 |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services | 1.0 |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Has 4 of 5; Helm is missing | 0.8 |
| 9 | Kafka | Not listed | 0.0 |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | 0.0 |
| | **Total** | | **7.8 / 10** |

**Mandatory match: 78%**

This sits exactly on the lower edge of the 78–84% band. I treated "between 78 and 84" as including both ends, so the combined check applies. If you meant to exclude the endpoints, 78% would fall outside the band and the combined check would not be triggered.

## Nice-to-Have Requirements (5)

| # | Requirement | Evidence | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | Grafana | Observability | 1.0 |
| 12 | Prometheus | Observability | 1.0 |
| 13 | Technical writing | Other | 1.0 |
| 14 | Mentoring | Other | 1.0 |
| 15 | Public speaking | Other | 1.0 |
| | **Total** | | **5.0 / 5** |

## Combined Figure (all 15 requirements)

7.8 + 5.0 = 12.8 out of 15, which is **85.3%**.

## Result

The combined figure reaches the 85% threshold, but only by about 0.3 points. **Recommendation: proceed.**

## Notes for the Reviewer
- **Gaps to probe:** Kafka, GraphQL and Helm. These are all mandatory, so they are worth raising in an interview.
- **Thin margins:** Both the band entry (exactly 78%) and the threshold pass (85.3%) are very close. Any change in how a requirement is credited would change the outcome. For example, if the Infrastructure line were read as not fully showing hands-on Ansible, the candidate would fall below the threshold.
